short: Elements, ports, the clock, the string builder
is: Four public modules: the nouns (elements), the seams (ports), the one clock type, and the shared string-validation builder.
conventions: A new port area adds a file under `ports/` rather than growing `mod.rs`.
Time is injected, never read from the ambient clock.

fs.name: datetime.rs
fs.role: DateTimeUtc — the single injected clock type

fs.name: elements.rs
fs.role: module index for elements/, live entities vs stubs

fs.name: lib.rs
fs.role: crate root; the ports-and-adapters position and the eventual split

fs.name: ports.rs
fs.role: module index for ports/, re-exports the port traits flat

fs.role: trait seams: unit_of_work.rs = Database/UnitOfWork traits; account, user, profile, identity, identity_resolver (IdentityResolver — handle↔DID lookups of actors Zurfur does not own), changelog, commission, character, file, workflow, authenticator, public_records ports; errors.rs shared (incl. ResolveError)

fs.role: StringBuilder: the one trimmed/capped-string gate every newtype validates through (ZMVP-113)

fs.role: split of string_builder.rs; no information beyond its façade

notes: Adapters: `adapter-pg` implements the private-store ports, `adapter-atproto` the public ones (`PublicRecords`, the real `DidMinter`), `adapter-mem` fakes both.

`UnitOfWork` vends exactly eight write ports: `accounts`, `commissions`, `changelog`, `users`, `actor_identities`, `workflows`, `columns`, `characters`. `ports::Unit<'a>` names `&'a mut dyn UnitOfWork`, the type a `#[unit]` parameter takes.

Documented exceptions to the Unit of Work — pool-backed `&self` writes: `ProfileCache` (read-through cache fill), `FileStore` (blob bytes can't ride a Postgres transaction), and the api-side `session_store`/`auth_store`.
Changelog entries are appended in the same unit as the domain write they record, and nothing is derived from them (59310081).

`commission_element` carries a **composite** FK `(tab_id, commission_id) → commission_tab (id, commission_id)`, so an element citing another commission's tab is unwritable; `UnknownTab` is the friendly 404 half of that rule (45514754).
View grants are per-User, never per-Account; membership confers no view (29130754, amended 2026-09-04).
`DidOperations` is interface-only — no adapter implements it, and whether `tombstone`/`update_handle` migrate off `DidMinter` is an open Engineer ruling.
